messages:
erin (Support): ACME Trading filed a high-priority ticket: they require mid-stream function invokes in streaming completions, plus a final validated JSON `SETTLEMENT` frame.
erin (Support): Their example: model streams commentary, emits `EVENT:invoke_trade {"symbol":"MSFT","qty_partial":40}` mid-stream, later refines to qty 100, then final `SETTLEMENT` JSON. Compliance requires server-side validation of the final JSON.
kevin (Sales): Customer is on Dedicated and offered to be pilot. Wants ETA and risk summary.
sara (Eng): Current streaming supports text + final metadata only. Adding event frames is doable but needs envelope changes and SDK compatibility guarantees.

sara (Eng): Quick plan: 1) 3d spike to prototype event frame type that older SDKs ignore, 2) 2w implementation to route invokes immediately, 3) 1w for schema validation path.
mike (Product): Proposed beta acceptance: event frames present, routed to customer tool endpoints (Dedicated in-region median extra latency <500ms), final `SETTLEMENT` validated with structured error frames on failure, docs + SDK examples for pilot.
erin (Support): I've asked ACME for the JSON schema and peak QPS; legal-bot flagged NDA required.
legal-bot: NDA request created LGL-9201.
kevin (Sales): If spike looks good, I'll schedule pilot kickoff with ACME.
sara (Eng): Starting spike tomorrow; will post results here.
mike (Product): Marking this P0 for Dedicated pilot, P2 for Hosted GA. Next actions: @erin get NDA+schema+QPS, @sara run spike, @mike draft pilot criteria.
